summary: Get like count for blog post
description:
Returns the count of likes of specific blog post.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the content of the blog post and its corresponding space.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the blog post for which like count should be returned.

200.description: Returned if the requested count is returned.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if the calling user does not have permission to view the
requested blog post or the blog post was not found.
